scope: Collector graph worker and backend projection/identity/source audit; no unrelated UI changes reviewed

findings.title: Creator product identity collapses distinct options and duplicates stable products
findings.trigger: sourceEntryId is empty string, productUrl is null, and two named options share their first source URL
findings.actual: GraphProjection.apply reports products=2 but stores only Hero B keyring (one row), even with complete productCoverage for both names.
findings.related: Reordering sources with the same external identity.entryId also changes the key; stable productUrl with renamed product and null sourceEntryId creates another row.
findings.recommendation: Normalize blank IDs, enforce per-batch distinct identity, and reuse stable source-system ID / individual URL aliases.

findings.title: Verified empty discovery is rejected and repeatedly enriched
findings.trigger: DISCOVERY has events=[], searchStatus=COMPLETE and successfully opened sourceCoverage.checkedUrls
findings.actual: Worker require_opened rejects because DISCOVERY uses sourceCoverage, not coverage. Backend GraphProjection.checkSources lines28-30 repeats the same omission. Worker downgrades APPROVE to ENRICH and GraphService stores WAITING with a six-hour retry.
findings.recommendation: For empty discovery, intersect successfully opened URLs with sourceCoverage.checkedUrls, validate coverage completion, and allow COMPLETE/NO_RESULTS without accepting failed attempts.

verification.creatorOptionLoss: Actual GraphProjection.apply on isolated localhost test database, transaction rolled back
verification.emptyDiscovery: Reproduced in Python guard and actual compiled Java GraphProjection.checkSources
